overall: Audited all 17 supplied cases: 5 accepted repairs, 10 source fallbacks, and 2 accepted sample successes.

One material raw semantic defect was missed by both reviewers: ar05 strengthens a possible individual observation into a frequency claim. The ar19 ending concern is disputed between reviewers and remains separate from agreed hard counts.

The five repaired outputs are useful and source-grounded. Most repairs refine safe raw wording; ar19 specifically restores a more tentative ending. No repaired or accepted final introduces an identified material semantic defect.

Jointly good edits were lost in ar04, ar05, ar12, ar37, and ar40. Ar05's fallback protects against its missed raw defect but unnecessarily discards the rest of the edit; ar04's fallback leaves a known wrong date.

In ar07, ar14, ar27, and ar34, the replacement fact was never supplied. Their unchanged final text avoids guessing but does not complete the requested factual update; publication safety of the retained possibly outdated details is unresolved.
